description: Champion + desk-set dispute parameters (CANDIDATES CH207, development only): the champion's logistic learner and params on its features + the umaparams aux family (se-aux-umaparams-v1: up_has, the market's gamma_rules row known at the capture start; up_log_bond = log1p umaBond; up_log_reward = log1p umaReward; up_live_custom, customLiveness > 0; up_fallback, a fallbackResolutionType other than none; up_resolver_top, resolvedBy equal to the census's top address). The row's endDate / startDate are not read. Logistic like se28, so main effects only. Read against se0_champion_lr_mm.
